item.title: Arthur Fils destroys Tsitsipas in Miami Open | SportsRation
item.description: Arthur Fils delivered one of the most dominant performances of the tournament, crushing Stefanos Tsitsipas 6–0, 6–1 at the Miami Open 2026. item.title: Super Eagles Unveil New Jerseys Ahead of Friendly Tournament
item.description: The Super Eagles have unveiled their new home and away jerseys for the 2026/2027 football season, SportsRation reports.

item.title: Fulham Move Closer to Permanent Deal for Samuel Chukwueze
item.description: Fulham FC have taken a significant step towards signing Samuel Chukwueze on a permanent deal after opening talks with AC Milan over a possible summer transfer.

item.title: Werder Bremen Admit Loan Move for Victor Boniface Has Fallen Short
item.description: Werder Bremen sporting director Clemens Fritz has admitted that the club’s summer loan signing of Victor Boniface has not gone as planned.

item.title: Farioli Praises Terem Moffi as Porto Come From Behind to Beat Braga
item.description: FC Porto coach Francesco Farioli has praised the impact of Terem Moffi after Porto secured a 2‑1 comeback victory over Sporting Braga.

item.title: Wayne Rooney Says Phil Foden’s Cup Final Substitution Felt Like a “Charity”
item.description: Phil Foden’s late appearance in Manchester City’s Carabao Cup final win over Arsenal felt more like a “charity” substitution, according to former England captain Wayne Rooney.

item.title: Nigeria Referees Association President Sani Zubairu Passes Away After Illness
item.description: The President of the Nigeria Referees Association (NRA), Alhaji Sani Zubairu (FIFA rtd), is dead, SportsRation reports.

item.title: Heavens Race Academy Spreads Love at Uyo Destitute Home Ahead of NLO Season Kickoff
item.description: Players and officials of Heavens Race Football Academy on Monday, 23rd March 2026, visited St Anthony of Padua Destitute Home, Uruan Street, Uyo, in a show of love and support for the children, as they prepare for the upcoming Nationwide League season which begins in April.

item.title: Super Eagles’ Star Alex Iwobi Makes 2025 Football Black List for Off-Field Impact
item.description: Super Eagles midfielder Alex Iwobi has been named on the 2025 Football Black List for his outstanding contributions off the pitch.
